text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

The wins were real. Reps reclaimed about five hours a week previously spent on CRM updates. Follow-up emails went out same day instead of two days later. Managers could finally see what customers actually said, not just what reps remembered.

The surprises mattered more. Reps who asked permission up front got better conversations, not guarded ones. Summaries missed tone and hesitation, so the best reps still added their own two lines. And accuracy dropped sharply in noisy plant-floor visits.

Our takeaway: AI handles the record. Humans still own the read.

Next quarter, we're expanding with clearer consent scripts.

What did your team learn from a pilot?
